# Forage Denmark

> A free guide to wild food in Denmark: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 17 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Brændenælde. In season March to June.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Ramsløg. In season March to May.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Mælkebøtte. In season March to October.
- [Ground elder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/groundelder/): Aegopodium podagraria; Skvalderkål. In season March to June.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Fuglegræs. In season March to November.
- [Common sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/sorrel/): Rumex acetosa; Almindelig syre. In season April to August.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis acetosella; Skovsyre. In season April to September.
- [Garlic mustard](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/garlicmustard/): Alliaria petiolata; Løgkarse. In season March to June.
- [Fat hen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/fathen/): Chenopodium album; Hvidmelet gåsefod. In season May to September.
- [Ribwort plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/plantain/): Plantago lanceolata; Lancet-vejbred. In season April to September.
- [Hop shoots](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/hops/): Humulus lupulus; Humle. In season March to May.
- [Spruce tips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/spruce/): Picea abies; Granskud. In season May to June.
- [Sea beet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/seabeet/): Beta vulgaris subsp. maritima; Strandbede. In season March to October.
- [Marsh samphire](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/samphire/): Salicornia europaea; Kveller. In season June to August.
- [Sweet woodruff](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/woodruff/): Galium odoratum; Skovmærke. In season April to May.
- [Sugar kelp](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/kelp/): Saccharina latissima; Sukkertang. In season March to June.
- [Dulse](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/dulse/): Palmaria palmata; Søl. In season April to September.
- [Blue mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/mussel/): Mytilus edulis; Blåmusling. In season January to December.
- [Blackberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/blackberry/): Rubus fruticosus; Brombær. In season August to September.
- [Wild raspberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/raspberry/): Rubus idaeus; Hindbær. In season July to August.
- [Bilberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/bilberry/): Vaccinium myrtillus; Blåbær. In season July to August.
- [Lingonberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/lingonberry/): Vaccinium vitis-idaea; Tyttebær. In season August to October.
- [Wild strawberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/strawberry/): Fragaria vesca; Skovjordbær. In season June to July.
- [Elderberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/elderberry/): Sambucus nigra; Hyldebær. In season August to September.
- [Elderflower](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/elderflower/): Sambucus nigra; Hyldeblomst. In season May to June.
- [Sloe](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/sloe/): Prunus spinosa; Slåen. In season September to November.
- [Rose hips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/rosehip/): Rosa canina; Hyben. In season September to November.
- [Rowan berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/rowan/): Sorbus aucuparia; Røn. In season August to October.
- [Hawthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/hawthorn/): Crataegus monogyna; Hvidtjørn. In season September to October.
- [Crab apple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/crabapple/): Malus sylvestris; Skovæble. In season September to October.
- [Sea buckthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/seabuckthorn/): Hippophae rhamnoides; Havtorn. In season August to October.
- [Bog cranberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/cranberry/): Vaccinium oxycoccos; Tranebær. In season September to October.
- [Crowberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/crowberry/): Empetrum nigrum; Revling. In season August to September.
- [Wild blackcurrant](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/blackcurrant/): Ribes nigrum; Solbær. In season July to August.
- [Wild gooseberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/gooseberry/): Ribes uva-crispa; Stikkelsbær. In season June to July.
- [Juniper berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/juniper/): Juniperus communis; Ene. In season September to November.
- [Hazelnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/hazelnut/): Corylus avellana; Hasselnød. In season August to October.
- [Beechnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/beechnut/): Fagus sylvatica; Bog. In season September to October.
- [Meadowsweet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/meadowsweet/): Filipendula ulmaria; Almindelig mjødurt. In season June to August.
- [Lime blossom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/linden/): Tilia cordata; Lind. In season June to July.
- [Wild chamomile](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/chamomile/): Matricaria chamomilla; Kamille. In season June to August.
- [Wild thyme](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/thyme/): Thymus serpyllum; Smalbladet timian. In season June to August.
- [Yarrow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/yarrow/): Achillea millefolium; Røllike. In season June to September.
- [Red clover](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/redclover/): Trifolium pratense; Rødkløver. In season May to September.

## Dishes

- [Elderflower cordial (hyldeblomstsaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Flowers steeped with lemon and citric acid, sweetened and bottled. A Danish summer staple.
- [Sea buckthorn juice (havtornsaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/sea-buckthorn-juice/): Sour orange berries juiced and sweetened, rich in vitamin C.
- [Sloe schnapps (slåensnaps)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/sloe-schnapps/): Frosted sloes steeped in neutral spirit with a little sugar until Christmas.
- [Woodruff schnapps (skovmærkesnaps)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/woodruff-schnapps/): Wilted woodruff steeped briefly in aquavit.
- [Mussels in white wine (muslinger)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/mussels-in-white-wine/): Limfjord mussels steamed with wine, shallots and parsley.
- [Fried samphire (kveller)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/fried-samphire/): Samphire tossed in butter as a salty side for fish.
- [Wild garlic pesto (ramsløgspesto)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/wild-garlic-pesto/): Ramsons blended with oil, nuts and cheese.
- [Rose hip jam (hybenmarmelade)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/rose-hip-jam/): Seeded hips cooked into a tart orange jam.
- [Rowan jelly (rønnebærgelé)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Rowan with apple, set into jelly for game and roast pork.
- [Pickled elderflower capers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/pickled-elderflower-capers/): Green elderberries pickled like capers.
- [Nettle soup (brændenældesuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/nettle-soup/): Young nettles in a green soup with egg.
- [Sea beet with butter and fish](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/sea-beet-with-butter-and-fish/): Wilted sea beet with butter and lemon alongside fried plaice.
- [Hazelnut bread (hasselnødbrød)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/hazelnut-bread/): Rye bread studded with toasted hazelnuts.
- [Elderberry soup (hyldebærsuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/elderberry-soup/): Hot elderberry soup with apple and small dumplings.
- [Elderflower buttermilk (koldskål)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/elderflower-buttermilk/): Chilled buttermilk sweetened with elderflower, with kammerjunker biscuits.
- [Blackberry crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/blackberry-crumble/): Blackberries under a buttery oat crumble.
- [Raspberry and gooseberry trifle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/raspberry-and-gooseberry-trifle/): Summer berries layered with cream and macaroons.
